reviews.title: RAM that performs as good as it looks.
reviews.comment: Great RAM when it was $115 for the set. Runs at 6000 C30 all day long with 1.35v and looks better (subjective, of course) than some of the much larger, more known brands. I’d would love to buy more KLEVV products… when prices return to earth. The modules ran at their rated speeds without issue, but 6000 is better suited for my AMD rig.
reviews.author: Brendan van Varik

reviews.title: Best value DDR5 RAM at 7200 MHz
reviews.comment: This year, I decided to upgrade my old PC from an Intel Core i5-9600K 9th GEN with Corsair 64GB RAM running at 3200 MHz (which was overkill), and a PowerColor Red Devil RX 5700 XT graphics card to an AMD Ryzen 7800X3D, KLEVV CRASH V RGB 32GB RAM clocked at 7200 MHz, and a Sapphire Radeon RX 7900 XTX with 24GB. While searching for RAM at reasonable prices, I found the current market prices to be quite outrageous, especially for well-known brands offering RGB options. I compared prices for a 32GB 7200 MHz kit from Corsair Dominator White ($80 more), OLOY ($30 more), Trident ($25 more), and others. While I understand that CL34, CL36, and CL40 timings can make a slight difference, I didn't find it worth spending more money on. I tested this RAM with games like Diablo 4, Jedi Survivor, and COD, and found that it runs smoothly. It also performed well when transferring large files between drives, showing impressive speed and no issues. If you're looking to avoid overspending on RAM and instead invest in a better GPU, CPU, or motherboard, I recommend considering this option. It offers good quality and the best value for your money. Just keep in mind that you'll need to overclock it to reach 7200 MHz, as it defaults to 4800 MHz out of the box. Make sure to adjust this in your BIOS settings once it arrives. Good Luck!
reviews.author: Ronald Ayala
